newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile stocks seen gaining on rate cut expectations.
newsitem.headline: Chile stocks seen gaining on rate cut expectations.

text.p: Brokers expected Chilean stocks to gain ground Wednesday on continued expectations of a cut in interest rates this month or in July.
Economic data released Tuesday showed inflation well under control and slightly higher unemployment,both pointing to an interest rate cut sooner rather than later, Santiago newspapers said Wednesday.
Fresh rains in Santiago further eased any lingering concerns about the effects of drought on electrical concerns including Endesa, brokers said.
The blue-chip IPSA index ended Tuesday off 0.11 percent at 133.42 points on profit-taking after a long rally.
